name: deep-literature-workflow
description: Codex-native workflow for staged deep literature review projects with Obsidian vault output.

interface.shortDescription: Run staged AI literature reviews into Obsidian
interface.longDescription: A Codex-native staged workflow for deep literature research. It initializes a topic, discovers and screens papers, coordinates legal PDF acquisition, imports manual PDFs, rebuilds paper notes, and creates concept notes plus a review note for an Obsidian-compatible vault.
